comment: -p AMWI is the isotopically aware molecular weight, which uses the
isotope number as the mass of the atom. Pins two things: that an
isotopic atom contributes at all, and that its Hydrogens are counted.
Both were previously dropped - ether_13c used to report 44.034 rather
than 47.058, short by its three Hydrogens.
test.name: isotopes
